name: SOX Financial IT General Controls (ITGC) Compliance
description: Compliance framework for Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, covering IT General Controls (ITGC), change management, segregation of duties (SoD), financial reporting system access, and external audit evidence generation.

checklists.name: SOX 404 IT General Controls (ITGC) Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for SOX ITGC compliance across change control, security access, and system operations.

items.statement: Every production release affecting financial reporting applications is backed by an approved ticket and documented peer code review.
Segregation of Duties (SoD) matrix verifies zero conflicting permissions between software developers and production release engineers.
Quarterly privileged access reviews are conducted and signed off by application business owners.
Database schema migrations on financial ledgers preserve complete audit history and prohibit direct manual updates.
Disaster recovery failover and backup restoration tests are executed and documented annually.

reviewGates.name: SOX ITGC Internal Audit Sign-Off Gate
reviewGates.statement: The SOX Audit Lead confirms that change management, segregation of duties, and access control evidence satisfies SOX Section 404 ITGC standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Has Internal Audit verified change records, SoD rules, and ITGC evidence for SOX 404 compliance?
checklistIds: SOX 404 IT General Controls (ITGC) Audit Checklist

obligationDefinitions.title: A segregation-of-duties conflict in financially relevant systems must be remediated or compensated
obligationDefinitions.description: SOX ITGC requires that a user access review finding a segregation-of-duties conflict (e.g. one person can both create and approve a financial transaction) be remediated by access change or, where remediation isn't immediately possible, covered by a documented compensating control.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every SoD conflict identified in an access review is remediated or has a recorded, approved compensating control.

requiredEvidence.title: SoD conflict remediation record
requiredEvidence.description: Access review finding and its remediation or compensating-control disposition.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: User access review / IAM system export.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has every identified segregation-of-duties conflict been remediated or covered by an approved compensating control?
obligationDefinitions.assurance: Internal controls / SOX compliance lead sign-off.
